Game Overview

At its heart, Mononinja is a platformer game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Mononinja keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Mononinja?

Mononinja is a free platformer game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Mononinja free to play?

Yes, Mononinja is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
